svg.text: POST /api/loans (title, partnerName, loanDirection='BORROWED', principal, interestRate, termMonths, isDisbursed, walletId)
SELECT id, cached_balance FROM wallets WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO micro_loans (user_id, wallet_id, title, partner_name, loan_direction='BORROWED', principal_original, principal_remaining, status='ACTIVE') VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'BORROWED', ?, ?, 'ACTIVE')
INSERT INTO financial_transactions (user_id, transaction_type='LOAN_DISBURSEMENT', status='POSTED', amount=principal, description='Giải ngân khoản vay') VALUES (...)
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (transaction_id, ledger_account_id, entry_side='DEBIT', amount_base=principal) VALUES (txId, walletAccId, 'DEBIT', principal)
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (transaction_id, ledger_account_id, entry_side='CREDIT', amount_base=principal) VALUES (txId, loanLiabilityAccId, 'CREDIT', principal)
UPDATE wallets SET cached_balance = cached_balance + ? WHERE id = walletId
INSERT INTO micro_loans (user_id, title, partner_name, loan_direction='BORROWED', principal_original, principal_remaining, status='ACTIVE') VALUES (...)
SELECT id, user_id, principal_remaining, status FROM micro_loans WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? FOR UPDATE
Ném lỗi UnprocessableEntityException("Tiền gốc trả vượt quá số dư nợ còn lại")
SELECT cached_balance, earmarked_balance FROM wallets WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE
Ném lỗi UnprocessableEntityException("Ví chi trả không đủ số dư khả dụng")
INSERT INTO financial_transactions (user_id, transaction_type='LOAN_PAYMENT', status='POSTED', amount=(principalPaid + interestPaid), description='Thanh toán trả nợ vay') VALUES (...)
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (transaction_id, ledger_account_id, entry_side='DEBIT', amount_base=principalPaid) VALUES (txId, loanLiabilityAccId, 'DEBIT', principalPaid)
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (transaction_id, ledger_account_id, entry_side='DEBIT', amount_base=interestPaid) VALUES (txId, interestExpenseAccId, 'DEBIT', interestPaid)
INSERT INTO ledger_entries (transaction_id, ledger_account_id, entry_side='CREDIT', amount_base=(principalPaid + interestPaid)) VALUES (txId, walletAccId, 'CREDIT', (principalPaid + interestPaid))
UPDATE wallets SET cached_balance = cached_balance - ? WHERE id = walletId
INSERT INTO loan_payments (loan_id, transaction_id, principal_amount, interest_fee_amount, paid_on) VALUES (?, txId, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE micro_loans SET principal_remaining = 0, status = 'PAID_OFF' WHERE id = ?
UPDATE micro_loans SET principal_remaining = ? WHERE id = ?
